rules.rating: Integer 1 through 5, or explicitly unrated. Entered by the user. No calculation from book or website ratings.
rules.hidden: Separate Boolean from favorite membership and rating. Default false. Applies across catalogue author lists and book views, including Search, Groups and Favorites.
rules.coauthors_hidden: Any hidden coauthor hides the book while hidden-author filtering is enabled. An explicit Show hidden authors command reveals those books and identifies the active exception.
